source_event_audit.interpretation: Most new exact-name errors are plausibly caused by handle-prefixed renaming, including onStatClick(stat) and setFilter(filter.value) with arguments still present. One repeated closeModal click binding lacks even that static alias coverage. This is a conservative traceability result, not a browser-level proof of lost behavior.

guard.scope: Focused semantic repair attempts only, after candidate validation; candidate files remain available as evidence.
guard.behavior: A new unresolved source event binding is rejected; a plausible alias is marked review; either condition stops further automatic repair and prevents a pass label. Non-focused repair paths are unchanged.
limitations: Only callable SSM event expressions in the outer San template are statically traced; source assignments require separate handling.
A plausible alias does not prove runtime equivalence, element identity, or payload correctness.
The guard does not restore a prior code file; a rejected candidate remains a failed artifact with explicit stop reason.

bounded_syntax_normalization.added: Convert simple on-event.stop/prevent method calls and keyboard on-keyup/down/keypress.enter handlers into San value modifiers, preserving their original calls and arguments, including inline fire(name, payload).

bounded_empty_modifier_normalization.added: Convert bare on-event.stop/prevent attributes with no handler to San value modifiers and add one no-op method in each affected component scope.
bounded_empty_modifier_normalization.scope: Only genuinely empty modifier attributes in the outer template or inline san.defineComponent backtick templates; existing valued handlers and non-attribute text are unchanged.
bounded_empty_modifier_normalization.limitation: After this empty-only replay, valued fire(...) and key-filter events remain; the combined replay below handles their syntax. Neither replay establishes runtime parity.
